page_title: WOL 4-3 MAI | Wolfsburg v Mainz 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Timo Gerach sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+6' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Wolfsburg players aren’t happy.

90+4' 4 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) rises high inside the six-yard box to meet a cross by Maximilian Arnold from the free kick. He heads home into the middle of the goal, making the score 4:3.
90+4' It seemed like Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+1' Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) replaces Andreas Hanche-Olsen.
85' The attendance for today's match is 20036.
84' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Paul Nebel will be replaced by Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz).
84' Anthony Caci goes off the pitch and Silvan Widmer (Mainz) comes on.
84' 3 - 3 Goal! Joakim Maehle provides Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the left post. 3:3.
82' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
81' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Kilian Fischer and he is replaced by Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) will replace Tiago Tomas.
80' The resulting corner, taken by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), comes to nothing.
80' What a wasted opportunity by Anthony Caci (Mainz)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Kamil Grabara makes a decent save to thwart him.
78' The corner kick from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
75' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
74' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner but it's cleared.
73' Anthony Caci (Mainz) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
69' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to make a change. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) replaces Bence Dardai.
69' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mohamed Amoura.
68' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
66' 2 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Jonathan Burkardt is the provider as he slips the ball to Paul Nebel (Mainz) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 2:3.

66' What a wasted opportunity by Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top of the net, but Kamil Grabara makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
62' The shots on goal statistics – 3:2.
57' 2 - 2 Goal! Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Robin Zentner. He makes it 2:2.
56' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

54' What a wasted opportunity by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Robin Zentner makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
53' The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
52' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
52' The ball possession is 38:62.
47' The ball is out of play and Mainz manage to earn a corner.
46' Here is a change. Patrick Wimmer is going off and Ralph Hasenhuttl gives the last tactical orders to Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
46' Referee Timo Gerach blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Timo Gerach had an easy-decision to make.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
42' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
39' 1 - 2 Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) was in the right place to put the ball into the back of the net with his body. It's 1:2.
36' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and Timo Gerach immediately signals a free kick.
32' Wolfsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
28' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the shot whistles inches wide of the left post.
27' Referee Timo Gerach has finally had enough of Bo Henriksen and brandishes a yellow card at him!
27' Mainz are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
27' The game is interrupted. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
24' The referee awards a corner and Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) goes over to take it.
22' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
22' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) for his blatant foul.
20' 1 - 1 Goal! 1:1. Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
18' Great teamplay by Mainz as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
14' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' Dangerous play by Kaishu Sano (Mainz). Timo Gerach blows his whistle for a foul. Wolfsburg have a free kick.
12' 0 - 1 Paul Nebel (Mainz) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
11' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
9' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
5' Bo Henriksen is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Danny da Costa suffers an injury and Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) comes on.
2' Danny da Costa (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Timo Gerach will supervise the game today.
